## cluster

Run a cargoship cluster action from an Ansible inventory.

Include it as `colonel_byte.cargoship.cluster`.

Added in `colonel_byte.cargoship` 0.26.0.

Runs one cargoship action against the fleet described by the Ansible inventory, on the management node.

Every task carries `run_once: true` and delegates to `cargoship_delegate_to`. Cargoship converges the whole fleet in a single run, so a play over the fleet's own inventory would otherwise converge it once per host.

Ansible supplies the inventory and nothing else. It does not connect to the fleet, and nothing is installed on the managed nodes.

### Variables

| Variable                         | Type             | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cargoship_action`               | `str`            | `apply`     | The cargoship action to run. It selects which module the role calls. One of `apply`, `prepare`, `engine_config_sync`, `reset`, `kube_config`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `cargoship_package`              | `str`            | `""`        | The distro package to install, stage, or synchronise from. Required by every action except `reset` and `kube_config`, which install nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `cargoship_cluster`              | `dict`           | `{}`        | The settings that belong to the cluster rather than to any host. `name` and `loadbalancer` are required; `profiles`, `registries`, and `values` are optional and take the shape the inventory schema documents. See the inventory guide for the full document.                                                                                                                   |
| `cargoship_cluster_name`         | `str`            | `""`        | The cluster name, as a variable of its own rather than a key inside `cargoship_cluster`. Wins over `cargoship_cluster.name` when both are set. Left empty it changes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `cargoship_cluster_loadbalancer` | `str`            | `""`        | The hostname clients use to reach the control plane, as a variable of its own. Wins over `cargoship_cluster.loadbalancer` when both are set. Left empty it changes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `cargoship_cluster_profiles`     | `dict`           | `{}`        | The cluster's profiles, as a variable of its own. Wins over `cargoship_cluster.profiles` when both are set. Left empty it changes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `cargoship_cluster_registries`   | `list` of `dict` | `[]`        | The cluster's registries, as a variable of its own. This is the one most fleets have a single answer to, so it is the one worth putting in `group_vars/all.yml`. Wins over `cargoship_cluster.registries` when both are set. Left empty it changes nothing.                                                                                                                      |
| `cargoship_cluster_values`       | `dict`           | `{}`        | The package value overrides, as a variable of its own. Wins over `cargoship_cluster.values` when both are set. Left empty it changes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `cargoship_role_groups`          | `dict`           | `{}`        | The mapping from a cargoship role onto the Ansible groups that carry it, for an inventory that does not name its groups `controller` and `worker`. Left empty, the default mapping applies.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `cargoship_inventory_path`       | `str`            | `""`        | Where to write the generated Cluster document. A private temporary file when empty, removed after a run that succeeded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `cargoship_age_recipients`       | `list` of `str`  | `[]`        | Age public keys used to encrypt registry credentials written to disk in the generated inventory document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `cargoship_age_identity_files`   | `list` of `str`  | `[]`        | Paths to age identity files, or SSH private keys, used to decrypt registry credentials at apply time. Only `apply` and `engine_config_sync` read an encrypted value, so only those two are given the identities. The other three actions accept no such parameter and are not passed one, which makes setting this fleet-wide in `group_vars` safe whichever action a play runs. |
| `cargoship_log_file`             | `bool`           | `null`      | Whether to always write a full-verbosity debug log to a file, regardless of log level. Unset by default. The module then renders no flag and whatever `cargoship-config.yaml` says still applies; a literal `false` is a decision that overrules a config file asking for the log.                                                                                               |
| `cargoship_args`                 | `dict`           | `{}`        | Everything else the chosen module takes, passed through verbatim. See the generated module pages for the parameters of each module. A parameter the role assembles from a variable of its own -- `package`, `inventory_path`, `log_file`, `age_recipient`, `age_identity_file` -- is refused here rather than silently overriding it. Set the matching role variable instead.    |
| `cargoship_delegate_to`          | `str`            | `localhost` | The node cargoship runs on. It is the management node: the one the package and images were staged onto, which reaches the fleet over SSH. Set this to the inventory name of that node when it is not the Ansible controller.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `cargoship_no_log`               | `bool`           | `true`      | Whether to suppress task parameter and result logging. Defaults to `true` to avoid exposing decrypted credentials and fleet inventories in logs. Set to `false` when debugging locally.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `cargoship_show_result`          | `bool`           | `false`     | Whether to print cargoship's own report on the run. The task itself defaults to `no_log: true`, because a module's arguments name the fleet; the report holds file paths and phase names and no key material.                                                                                                                                                                    |
